options.name: bindir
options.description: Install executables into a specific directory.

options.name: build_flags
options.description: Allow adding build flags for gem compilation.

options.name: env_shebang
options.description: Rewrite the shebang line on installed scripts to use /usr/bin/env.

options.name: executable
options.description: Override the path to the gem executable.

options.name: force
options.description: Force gem to (un-)install, bypassing dependency checks.

options.name: gem_source
options.description: The path to a local gem used as installation source.

options.name: include_dependencies
options.description: Whether to include dependencies or not.

options.name: install_dir
options.description: Install the gems into a specific directory. These gems are independent from the global installed ones. Specifying this requires user_install to be false.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the gem to be managed.

options.name: norc
options.description: Avoid loading any C(.gemrc) file. Ignored for RubyGems prior to 2.5.2. The default changed from V(false) to V(true) in community.general 6.0.0.

options.name: override_platform_install_dir
options.description: Resolve the user gem installation directory via C(gem environment) and pass it explicitly as C(--install-dir) to both C(gem install) and C(gem uninstall), instead of using C(--user-install). This is needed on distributions (such as Fedora) where a platform-specific C(operating_system.rb) injects C(--install-dir) as a default for all gem commands, which conflicts with C(--user-install) and causes C(gem uninstall) to search the wrong directory. options.name: pre_release
options.description: Allow installation of pre-release versions of the gem.

options.name: repository
options.description: The repository from which the gem is installed.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the gem. V(latest) ensures that the latest version is installed.

options.name: user_install
options.description: Install gem in user's local gems cache or for all users.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of the gem to be installed/removed.
